title: TokenCreateRequest
description: Request body for creating a new npm access token.

password.description: The user's npm account password, required to authorize token creation.

readonly.description: Set to true to create a read-only token.

automation.description: Set to true to create an automation token that bypasses two-factor authentication for publishing.

cidr_whitelist.description: List of CIDR IP ranges to restrict where this token can be used from.
